cause: layer_merge.collect_statistics held every involved block's activations twice (the full captured rows and their statistics-position copy) and every block's head writes for a chunk at once: at DMR1's 29 blocks and 20 pairs, 9.7 GB of writes + 6.5 GB of captured rows + 2.4 GB of copies beside the 8 GB teacher and the 15.1 GB of float64 Pearson moments: 41.68 GiB allocated when a 320 MiB request failed on the 44.39 GiB L40S. RI-LM1 (14 blocks, 8 pairs) fit; the proposal scaled its time, not its memory.
repair: rows kept only at the statistics positions (indexed in the hook), FFN features released after their moments, head writes one span at a time; every accumulator receives the same additions in the same order (bit-for-bit equality test against the old collector; overlapping spans refused). Estimated peak ~29-31 GB on the L40S, same card.
